note: Gear rarity (D-087). Every weapon or armor piece a player gets is rolled once into an instance: a tier by weight, a condition in that tier's range, and (pristine / legendary) a chance of a free mod; legendary also rolls a perk for its kind. mult scales damage (weapons) or damage resistance (armor). Condition 0-1 wears with use: damage x lerp(cond_floor_weapon, 1, cond), resistance x lerp(cond_floor_armor, 1, cond). Repair at a workbench: repair_scrap_per_cond scrap per full bar (rounded up, at least 1). Golden Ace and other fixed items set their own tier in items.json (fixed_rarity).
